name: Firazorexton
summary: Firazorexton is an experimental orexin 2 (OX2) receptor agonist first described in a 2019 patent filed by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company.

pharmacology.text: Firazorexton (INN; development code TAK-994) is an experimental orexin 2 (OX2) receptor agonist first described in a 2019 patent filed by Takeda Pharmaceutical Company.
pharmacology.kind: Orexin OX2 receptor agonist; Wakefulness-promoting agent

uses.text: Firazorexton was studied by Takeda for the treatment of narcolepsy. The compound reached phase 2 clinical trials for narcolepsy.
